concept: turn this mannequin into a burly orc warrior: green skin, a heavy underbite jaw with two big tusks at the mouth corners, small angry eyes under a thick brow, a dented iron half-helm with a nose guard, a big spiked iron pauldron on one shoulder and a leather one on the other, a studded leather chest harness over a bare muscular chest, a wide belt with a big iron buckle, a short ragged hide skirt, wrapped forearms and heavy boots; for the whole roster: a chunky stylized dungeon-crawler monster with heroic stylized proportions (big head, short limbs), a bold readable silhouette, exaggerated oversized accessories, a limited palette of four to six flat colors, empty hands (no weapons)
